newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound Lines Inc Nov ticket sales up.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound Lines Inc Nov ticket sales up.

text.p: NOTE: 1) All statistics are unaudited, in thousands unless otherwise noted, and are for Greyhound Lines, Inc., only. These statistics do not include the company's bus operating subsidiaries.

2) These statistics are for sales generated by 198 of the company's largest locations which electronically report sales. The same locations are used for 1995 and 1996 and represent about 71 and 72 percent, respectively, of total monthly sales. The company's smaller locations have not shown the same rate of growth in sales and passenger counts.

It is necessary to adjust the sales totals for refunds, unredeemed tickets, interline activity and other miscellaneous items to reflect revenues and related statistics for financial statement purposes.
3) Includes all Greyhound Lines Inc locations. Does not include bus operating subsidiaries.
